title: Viavi twin: Cell edge coverage lost
description: Static-threshold anomaly detector on the cell metric log.viavi_twin.rsrp_p10_dbm (extracted from the twin's records by the gy-viavi-twin pipeline), one series per cell. Fires when the value is below -125 in 2 of the last 3 minutes. Breaking Barriers Track 3.

input.value: timeseries x = avg(log.viavi_twin.rsrp_p10_dbm), by: {dt.smartscape_source.id, twin.cell_full, twin.criticality, twin.network_name}, interval: 1m

properties.value: Cell edge coverage lost on the Viavi twin
The weakest tenth of the phones on {dims:twin.cell_full} (criticality {dims:twin.criticality}) see RSRP below -125 dBm.
